description: mcp.importFile answers the params shape error (-32602) when mode is not one of the two named acts: a plan (dry-run) and a mutation (replace) are different things, and the door refuses to guess which one a human meant — no default exists. The same refusal shape covers a relative path, a directory, a symlink to a directory, or a missing file: the door imports one absolute regular file. Params carrying an actor key are refused as a shape error before any of this runs (rejectIdentityKeys), because the actor is the peer credential, never a claim.

error.message: invalid params: mcp.importFile mode must be "dry-run" or "replace" — got "yolo"; a plan and a mutation are different acts and there is no default
